article.title: 更進新聞：京東披露雙11眼鏡虛擬試戴及美妝數碼人直播
article.summary: 京東稱，今年雙11把虛擬試用擴至眼鏡，並升級App內的東東購物助手。
highlights: 東東可協助比較價格、查詢優惠及尋找售後服務。
京東列出蘭蔻中國電商負責人的數碼人主持促銷直播的案例。
article.why: 零售團隊可按品類選工具，分別檢查試戴、問答和直播能否回答顧客的問題。
article.next_step: 先用一組眼鏡或美妝商品測試，記錄產品資料錯誤、未解問題及需要轉接人員的環節。
article.detail: 京東在雙11回顧中列出三種顧客接觸方式，包括為眼鏡加入虛擬試戴、在購物App升級東東助手，以及讓代表蘭蔻中國電商負責人的數碼人主持一節促銷直播。品牌可分開評估試戴、購物問答和直播的用途，並核對商品規格、優惠及售後資訊能否在各入口保持一致。該回顧聚焦京東平台內的做法。
article.title_en: Update: JD.com details eyewear try-ons and a beauty avatar livestream
article.summary_en: JD.com says it extended virtual try-ons to eyewear during Singles' Day and upgraded Dongdong, its in-app shopping assistant.
highlights_en: Dongdong helps compare prices, navigate promotions and find after-sales service.
JD.com describes a promotional livestream hosted by an avatar representing Lancôme China's ecommerce president.
article.why_en: Retailers can choose tools by category and check whether try-ons, Q&A and livestreams answer shoppers' questions.
article.next_step_en: Test one eyewear or beauty assortment and log incorrect product information, unanswered questions and requests for staff.
article.detail_en: JD.com's Singles' Day recap described virtual eyewear try-ons, the updated Dongdong assistant and a promotional livestream hosted by an avatar representing Lancôme China's ecommerce president. Brands can review the purpose of each format and check whether product specs, offers and after-sales details stay consistent across entry points. The recap covers practices on JD.com's platform.
article.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
article.followup: 11月13日版報道雙11大市估算。京東回顧早於該期公布，今次補充平台的試戴、購物問答及直播案例。
article.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered the market estimate. JD.com's earlier recap adds platform examples of try-ons, shopping Q&A and livestreaming.
